ns2:section.sectionText: 3-4 hours Topic: Intelligent Mobile Navigation. Implement a navigation aid on a Nokia N95 smartphone, in order to learn the basic principles of motion planning (embedded software development, localization and mapping, search algorithms, and human-machine interaction). Time to be arranged at first meeting 4:30 pm on Tuesday, August 26 in Room 203 Trans. Bldg. Contact Prof. Bretl at tbretl@illinois.edu if you cannot attend the first meeting.
